rationale: Run position, unchanged records: three sourced findings stand with receipts and limits, and no necessary work is unfinished. (1) omnipaxos_runtime's unconsumed bounded event stream parks the actor loop and, once two of three nodes park, the cluster stops deciding - witnessed at event_capacity 8, 64 and the shipped default 1024 (receipts ff4511e8, 76557a28, bbff5b4c), with the superseded harness transport jam kept as an excluded cause; limits: client-side trigger with no documented drain obligation, a dropped receiver unblocks the actor, parked-set size is schedule-dependent. (2) The core has no timer-driven repair for a lost Accepted reply, so in the 2-node case the quorum-accepted entry stays undecided for 100 resend periods with only heartbeats on the wire (receipt 092538c6, control and later-proposal repair in the same run); limit: only the 2-node configuration was probed, where one dropped receipt is exactly what the quorum still needs. (3) append_notify can resolve Ok(idx) for an entry that was never decided at idx, shadowing the documented Superseded heuristic, and the scope is measured: unadopted entry -> false Ok, adopted entry -> truthful Ok (receipt 78c53df3); limits: both constructions deliberate, Ok semantics a contract reading, 2s tick cadence only. No new inference, execution or citation is added here.
